raw.details:
Overview

TechCircuit is a national-level online hackathon where students, developers and designers can transform innovative ideas into functional technology products.

  • Hackathon Starts: 20 October 2026
  • Duration: 48 hours
  • Mode: Completely online
  • Team Size: 1–4 members
  • Registration Fee: Absolutely FREE
  • Verifiable Digital Certificate for all participants

Top 3 teams receive

  • Incubation opportunities
  • PPO opportunities
  • n8n Pro Plan
  • Winner certificates and project recognition

All teams will receive will receive .xyz domain

$100 IN TECHNOLOGY CREDITS FOR EVERY ELIGIBLE PARTICIPANT

100+ REWARD RECIPIENTS across the main hackathon, track awards, sponsor challenges, mini-challenges and giveaways.

Eligible participants may also receive:

  • Mentorship and technical resources
  • Portfolio-ready product-building experience
  • Project promotion through organizer and partner communities
  • Additional sponsor and mini-challenge rewards

VERIFIABLE DIGITAL CERTIFICATES

Every eligible participant who completes the hackathon and makes a valid final submission will receive a verifiable digital participation certificate. Registration alone will not qualify a participant for a certificate.

Incubation, PPOs, and partner benefits are subject to eligibility requirements, availability and the respective partner’s selection process.

Join the group for information: https://chat.whatsapp.com/Ey2INJ6Uq4c3Mk0Wez89RD

Build something useful. Compete nationally. Take your idea beyond the hackathon.
